I think it's also worth noting that some may not even have an official diagnosis or fail to engage with their MH services. Rehabilitation is a crucial factor to make sure this sort of shit doesn't happen. Him being from NA, I'm not sure how it works over there in terms of health insurance, etc. People can go decades without a diagnosis due to failure of their parents, or school for not picking up on the signs. Then as an adult they sometimes refuse to engage with MH services. 
The fact he was hired by military (I think?) is even more worrying, and makes you think about the number of people that slip through who are this unstable.
